name: Standard Sales Order Processing (Happy Path)
trigger: Inbound SOAP request received at /Glovia_SalesOrder with standard Sales Order notification payload matching route condition Glovia_Route_SalesOrder
expected_outcome: HTTP 202/200 OK accepted, headers (Region, Country, TimeStamp, BusinessObject, Sender) enriched, routed via SequenceFlow_82 to Message Mapping 1, headers logged via Interface_Generic_Headers.groovy, and successfully finalized at EndEvent_2
validates: CallActivity_4 (Property & Header Enricher), ExclusiveGateway_80 routing condition Glovia_Route_SalesOrder, CallActivity_102 (Message Mapping), CallActivity_13 (Header logging), and EndEvent_2

name: Sales Order Return Route Processing
trigger: Inbound SOAP request with order type indicating return, satisfying condition Glovia_Route2_ReturnSalesOrder
expected_outcome: Message routed through SequenceFlow_113, executes CallActivity_71 (Interface_Generic_Headers.groovy), sets custom header properties for tracking, and reaches EndEvent_9 without invoking sales order mapping
validates: ExclusiveGateway_80 condition Glovia_Route2_ReturnSalesOrder, CallActivity_71 script execution, and EndEvent_9 completion

name: Unmatched Routing Condition - Escalation Default Route
trigger: Inbound SOAP request with unrecognized OrderTypeCode not matching either SalesOrder or ReturnSalesOrder route expressions
expected_outcome: Router defaults to SequenceFlow_110, triggering EscalationEndEvent EndEvent_11 with error code 'RoutingConditionNotMet'
validates: ExclusiveGateway_80 default path branch and EndEvent_11 EscalationEndEvent handling

name: Mapping Failure and Exception Subprocess Activation
trigger: Inbound SOAP request matching SalesOrder route with schema-incompatible XML content causing runtime mapping exception in CallActivity_102
expected_outcome: Exception SubProcess_91 catches error via StartEvent_92, restores original message via CallActivity_97 (${property.InputPayload}), logs attachment via CallActivity_100 (Log_Payload.gsh), and terminates via Error EndEvent_95
validates: SubProcess_91 execution, CallActivity_97 property extraction, CallActivity_100 attachment logging, and EndEvent_95 error propagation

name: Malformed Inbound XML Payload at SOAP Adapter
trigger: Malformed XML structure (unclosed tags, invalid syntax) received at /Glovia_SalesOrder
expected_outcome: SOAP adapter rejects payload before enrichment with HTTP 400 or triggers StartEvent_92 exception subprocess if parsed inside the flow
validates: SOAP sender adapter validation and boundary handling for corrupt inbound XML streams

name: Header and Property Boundary Evaluation
trigger: Valid SOAP notification payload with missing optional header externalized parameters and unicode order characters
expected_outcome: CallActivity_4 creates properties without NullPointerExceptions, retains complete XML payload in InputPayload property, and successfully executes generic header logging
validates: CallActivity_4 property table handling and parameter substitution resilience
